consistency_log.description: Validation status aggregation: overall_status from each section recorded for downstream review (informational)
consistency_log.source_basis: excellence_section.json validation_status.overall_status=inferred (mix of source_grounded confirmed claims and synthesis-based inferred claims across sub-sections 1.1–1.4); impact_section.json validation_status.overall_status=inferred (confirmed identity-spine claims alongside inferred interdisciplinary synthesis claims in sections 2.1–2.3); implementation_section.json validation_status.overall_status=inferred (confirmed WP/task/deliverable/milestone claims alongside inferred probability-impact estimates for risks and governance cadence assumptions). All three sections carry overall_status=inferred. No section carries overall_status=unresolved. Downstream review should confirm that inferred claims (particularly risk probability-impact assessments, governance meeting cadence, and demonstrator TRL synthesis judgements) are appropriately flagged in the final review packet.
